tools.name: deck.info
tools.description: Inspect a presentation in your workspace (.pptx, .deckcraft or outline text): its slides with titles, layouts and shape counts, sections and theme. Reads only. `path` is relative to your workspace, the folder your own file tools (list_dir, read_file) see; files outside it cannot be named.

tools.name: deck.run
tools.description: Run up to 64 commands from the deck engine's catalog, in order, on the presentation at `path` in your workspace, or on a new empty presentation, then write it as .pptx, .deckcraft, outline .txt or .pdf, or one slide (`slide`, 0-based) as a .png at most `max_side` pixels long to `out` when given. Each command is {id, params}. Only reviewed commands run: those the skill's commands.md lists untagged (work inside the document), and the picture, audio and video commands that read a file from your workspace; anything that reaches other files, code, the network, devices or the app is refused before any command runs. Paths are relative to your workspace, and `out` must be a new file. Read the deck-engine skill first.
